verse: He must increase, but I must decrease.—John 3:30.
title: Becoming Less So He Becomes More
bullets: When we empty ourselves of pride and self-seeking, we make room for Christ's light to fill our hearts completely.
True messengers of God care nothing for their own honor—they gladly point others to Jesus, the Lamb of God who takes away sin.
The Holy Spirit works without measure in hearts that have surrendered every thought and desire to obey Christ.
prayer: Lord, empty me of self so that You might increase in my life. Help me to point others to Jesus rather than seeking praise for myself, and fill me with Your Spirit as I surrender every thought to Your will.
